# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want epic #1 and everything under it audited, so that "Buildable project foundation: module layout, root Gradle bui" is accurate and test-backed

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** epic #1 and every story and task under it audited
**So that** "Buildable project foundation: module layout, root Gradle build, CI templates, local infrastructure" describes what was actually built, and every criterion is backed by a test or a re-runnable command

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given epic #1, when audited in epic mode, then it matches the epic
      template, meets the writing standard, and its native sub-issue links are
      complete and correct
- [x] Given story #83 and its 4 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#255)
- [x] Given every criterion in this subtree, when it is read, then it names a
      test, a CI step, or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date
      (`audit-check.py <epic> --tree` reports none)
- [x] Given every issue in this subtree, when its metadata is read, then it has
      one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N` label, and a correct
      native parent link (`audit-check.py <epic> --tree`)
- [x] Given every child story is audited, when epic #1 is checked, then it
      is closed if all its stories are closed, and left open otherwise

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 3

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
Scope: epic #1, its 1 stories, and the 4 tasks under them.

Method is `/audit-artifacts`: epic mode for the epic body, story mode for each
child story. One audit task per story under review.
